summary.text: Boundless Forest Samsara is Ren Zu's fourth child in The Legends of Ren Zu. She comes out of an accomplishment tree inside ordinary abyss.

claims.text: When Ren Zu’s accomplishment tree crown reaches the height of ordinary abyss, the trunk cracks open and a girl comes out calling him father. The text names her Ren Zu’s fourth child, Boundless Forest Samsara. She loves the fruits of the forest, grows healthy and well-fed, and urges Ren Zu to stay rather than keep trying to leave the abyss. When he climbs the tree carrying her, cognition Gu says the accomplishment tree cannot help others become extraordinary, and self Gu bites her hand so she falls back into ordinary abyss while Ren Zu steps out.

After Ren Zu climbs the giant tree and walks out of ordinary abyss, he leaves her behind. He has become extraordinary and can no longer enter ordinary abyss, then sets out again seeking a way to rescue both Verdant Great Sun and Boundless Forest Samsara.

Separated from Ren Zu, she can only stay in ordinary abyss. When a miniman falls near her, she sees a person not even the size of her finger, feels curious, and asks who he is. The miniman looks at her with a stupefied look and cries loudly, and she asks why he is crying when she is not.

In a fuller telling of The Legends of Ren Zu, Boundless Forest Samsara befriends a miniman inside Ordinary Abyss and joins him chopping trees to build a ladder out. When strength Gu emerges from a felled tree and offers her great strength in exchange for her youth, she accepts, and her ladder quickly grows far taller than the miniman’s. Over the following years she grows lazy and spends less and less time building, mocking the miniman’s slow progress, until he finishes his own ladder first, and perseverance Gu is born from his own body as he leaves the abyss.
No chapter describes her face or clothing beyond naming her a girl who comes out of the tree.
